items.title: The race to find routes around the Strait of Hormuz and which nation is winning
items.description: Amid uncertainty around the Strait of Hormuz, for months Gulf countries and oil companies have been finding ways to bypass the choke point.

items.title: Subsidy changes prompt battery installation collapse
items.description: Federal subsidies have ignited huge demand for batteries, but a tightening of the rules has experts warning of "boom and bust" cycles for the industry.

items.title: Young people say doctors missing signs of bowel cancer
items.description: Georgie Cauchi had blood in her stool, constant pain and was struggling to get out of bed, but still in her 20s doctors told her she was too young to have bowel cancer. When it was finally discovered several years later, the tumour had grown so large it was blocking her entire bowel.

items.title: Millions of couples share this remarkable trait. Researchers still don't know why
items.description: Once I saw it, I couldn't unsee it. Had I noticed something real or was it just the people around me? I set out to find out what the data had to say.

items.title: Hanson quiet on who paid for Italy trip before speaking at pricey dinner
items.description: One Nation leader Pauline Hanson refuses to say who paid for her recent trip to Italy, where she attended a fashion show and was spotted at a five-star resort.

items.title: Malcolm Roberts falsely claimed COVID-19 vaccines caused miscarriages

items.title: Irish national admits role in 'nightmare' plan to help alleged criminal flee Australia

items.title: Going after the media a tried and true tactic of diversion

items.title: 'Bring back public flogging': Inquiry hears of vicious online trolling

items.title: Sydney suburbs which recorded rent price drops, as 'real test' looms

items.title: Sam Neill's advice for when the world seems too dark

items.title: Failed interns get a second chance to become doctors in new Aussie drama

items.title: 'Palestine will disappear before our eyes': Calls for Israel to stop settlements

items.title: The LNP's new crime statistics could be comparing 'apples and oranges'

items.title: 'Divided response': Presbyterian Church bars women from senior roles

items.title: Mother furious after Canberra childcare centre ordered to close

items.title: Artist behind Clinton portrait in Epstein files remembers first piece

items.title: How clogging and crafting saved a rural Tasmanian town hall from closure
